description:
Deletes a project asynchronously.

This operation is:

 *  transactional, that is, if part of the delete fails the project is not deleted.
 *  [asynchronous](#async). Follow the `location` link in the response to determine the status of the task and use [Get task](#api-rest-api-3-task-taskId-get) to obtain subsequent updates.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The project ID or project key (case sensitive).
parameters.name: projectIdOrKey

303.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

404.description: Returned if the project is not found or the user does not have the necessary permission.
